status: Strong El Niño likely this winter
detail: NOAA's October 8, 2026 outlook gives a greater than 83% chance of a strong to very strong El Niño through January to March 2027.

events.text: Governor Newsom declared a state of emergency for storms expected to be of historic severity.
San Mateo County declared a local El Niño emergency and formed a preparedness task force.
